entity.name: Umair Ashraf
entity.description:
I'm a developer interested in preserving digital freedoms and the decentralised and open nature of the internet. I like breaking down barriers in the cyberspace with FOSS technologies.

Sometimes I can't shake the feeling that the system we're living in isn't quite what it seems. That there is no spoon.

projects.name: Riamu Mail App
projects.description: The Riamu Mail App is a distributed email application that solves many problems and makes distributed email possible. Email was meant to be distributed and free.

channels.description: Please use my buymeacoffee link for now, in future I may consider other ways to fund me

plans.name: Full-time work on the project for research, development, testing, maintenance and upkeep
plans.description: This will cover the research, development, testing, maintenance and upkeep for a whole month. Pay what you can. The amount is an ideal goal for a month.

plans.name: Research and Development for Android Phones with LTE/5G etc
plans.description: Getting the mail server to work on Android phone over mobile networks (LTE/5G) will truly be a game changer technology. This will enable anyone to use their phone as a mail server and truly be distributed. Pay what you can. The amount is an ideal goal for this project.
